children: shares rose 6.90% intraday after Wells Fargo raised its price target to $796 from $640 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing early signs of a new product cycle following the performance of Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 model.

Wells Fargo left its revenue estimates unchanged and actually cut its 2026 operating income estimate by 12%, mostly for an expected $10 billion legal-settlement charge in the third quarter. The higher target came instead from stretching the valuation multiple to 25x the firm's 2027 earnings estimate, up from 20x.

Adding to the day's news flow, Meta announced Petal, a subsea cable it describes as the first to deliver petabit-scale capacity across an ocean. The system will link the U.S. and France over roughly 7,000 kilometers, carry 1 petabit per second, double the capacity of current best-in-class transoceanic cables. It will enter service in 2029, built with NEC and Sumitomo Electric, with Orange handling the French landing.

title: Meta Stock Jumps as Wells Fargo Underwrites the AI Story
